authorization: User resumed bounded research and requested an executable mature plan; FM remains primary. No new model training or checkpoint loading in this phase.
current_reference: H8 isolated engineering candidate; historical baseline comparisons are synthetic only
hypothesis: Calibrated local observation information can improve conditional-FM hypotheses and whole-candidate decisions under changing binocular ambiguity, without collapsing meaningful modes or compromising well-observed regions.

novelty.candidate_difference: One local observation-information representation conditions generation and modulates whole-SMPL-H candidate risk; pose-marginalized shape information is monitored, with causal ambiguity and rejection explicitly preserved.

issues.problem: FM single-sample synthetic error worse than regression
issues.decision: Keep FM primary; compare distributions and selected outputs separately, retain matched regression

issues.problem: No independent real accuracy or shape truth established
issues.decision: Separate synthetic, fitted-label and independent real evidence; real-claim gate stays blocked without truth
Use nested K=1,8,32,64; default K32, Euler8

issues.problem: Joint-wise coordinate averaging can leave the body-model family
issues.decision: Final estimator selects one complete candidate; coordinate averaging remains diagnostic control

issues.problem: Existing author RPEA uses GT root
issues.decision: Use each candidate predicted T and raw-fisheye projection; prohibit GT fields in inference

issues.problem: Observation reweighting of conditional samples can double count evidence
issues.decision: Keep raw ensemble uniform; proposed scores are decision costs, never exact posterior weights

issues.problem: Fixed K8 shape lock can lock early bias
issues.decision: Joint FM includes beta, one identity-shape random variable per current posterior draw; observation-only causal memory revises estimates
Monitor Schur-complement data information; do not count regularizer as data evidence
Fit joint/view/radius-conditioned error model on separate detector calibration data, otherwise mark geometry scores as proxies
Explicit state API, physical timestamps and observation ages; no-output gap policy unchanged

issues.problem: Shared random seed does not identify temporal mode
issues.decision: Independent frame-keyed noise for primary distribution evaluation; semantic distance only for causal near-tie decision

issues.problem: Partial labels do not identify unlabelled full-body distribution
issues.decision: Full 52-node claim requires credible complete labels; separate 22-node study if unavailable, no fabricated hand targets

issues.problem: 6D valid rotations do not imply manifold FM or anatomical validity
issues.decision: Retain guarded 6D first, report degeneracy; manifold upgrade is separate later factor

issues.problem: Local fish-eye geometry and COCO surface semantics may mismatch
issues.decision: Reuse declared landmark operator and current camera model; forbid pinhole substitution and SMPL-joint identity mapping

issues.problem: H8 wrappers not a complete training entry
issues.decision: New isolated package with one explicit state API and matching training/inference graph; frozen modules remain controls

issues.problem: No aggregation can recover an absent correct mode
issues.decision: Report oracle coverage gap separately; if oracle poor, fix generator/data before selector

architecture.model_name: working description: observation-information-conditioned joint FM with whole-candidate risk decisions
architecture.state: x_t=[52*6D local rotations, translation3, beta10], 325 standardized coordinates; 22-node fallback is a distinct 145-coordinate scope
architecture.probabilistic_target: q_theta(R_t,T_t,beta | admitted observations up to t, camera model, timestamps); amortized conditional approximation, not certified posterior
architecture.condition: COCO17 raw pixels, confidence, all original masks/rejections, rays, camera identities, timestamps, elapsed times; optional hands fixed identically across controls
architecture.geometry_information: Jacobian of raw-fisheye landmark residual at uniform candidate medoid; standardized local tangent coordinates (169 for52,79 for22); Lambda=J^T W J; no prior in reported data information
architecture.geometry_iteration: Warm model G0 produces anchor; info-conditioned G1 performs two complete FM passes (anchor then final). Both proposal and budget-matched controls pay two passes; no hidden one-pass latency claim.
architecture.geometry_conditioning: Per rotation/translation 3x3 information diagonal blocks and beta10x10 block encoded into corresponding velocity tokens; full matrix used for risk. Stop gradients through anchor/information in first implementation.
architecture.weak_information_weight: B=lambda0*(Lambda+lambda0*I)^-1; dimensionless standardized coordinates, lambda0 fixed on validation. B is a decision metric, not posterior covariance.
architecture.shape_information: S_beta=Lambda_bb-Lambda_bu*pinv(Lambda_uu)*Lambda_ub, u=pose+translation; local diagnostic only; whitening/noise calibration and temporal correlations required
architecture.backbone: width128, heads4, velocity blocks4; 52 pose tokens plus beta and translation tokens; observation-only GRU128 with explicit hidden/ages; no winner fed into observation memory
architecture.shape_behavior: Every admissible frame can return selected candidate beta; physical identity shape is static, posterior estimate can change. Do not EMA beta independently of selected pose/T.
architecture.missing_behavior: Advance ages without measurement update; retain internal shape state; current no-observation output remains unavailable. Timestamp gaps>0.5s disable temporal tie-break; identity reset clears all state.

default_sampler.primary_noise: independent frame-keyed counter stream; nested candidate indices

reference_sampler_sweep.rule: First K at8 steps, then steps atK32; no full grid unless justified

aggregation.raw_output: All candidates, seeds, masks, rejection reasons, complete R/T/beta and raw equal weights
aggregation.action_set: Numerically valid complete candidates passing a separately calibrated observation-consistency action gate; this gate does not change upstream observation admission or raw ensemble
aggregation.base_risk: R_k=mean_l delta_kl^T B delta_kl + lambda_g*E_raw_fisheye(k); l spans all numerically valid raw hypotheses; retain missing mass/counts, report raw and filtered scores separately
aggregation.delta: Pairwise shortest rotation logs, metric T difference and beta difference; standardized using training-only scales; blocks transported into anchor tangent. Near-pi chart or invalid Jacobian falls back explicitly to isotropic whole-candidate medoid.
aggregation.observation_cost: Mean robust whitened raw-fisheye landmark error on original admitted observations only; predicted candidate T required. Never use DA3 geometry or known-root labels.
aggregation.temporal_rule: Form candidates with R_k<=min(R)+delta_validation; only inside this near-tie set minimize physical-time-scaled distance to last published candidate. No frame revision or global future path optimization.
aggregation.ambiguity: Keep disconnected candidate modes in raw set; report sensitivity to two independent candidate pools and risk margin. Low decision stability yields ambiguous status, not fabricated certainty.
aggregation.clustering: Optional reporting only, threshold in physical standardized candidate distance chosen on validation; do not make arbitrary cluster count a core inference dependency
aggregation.not_probability: exp(-score) is not exported as calibrated posterior probability; no conditional q times reused likelihood without density-ratio derivation
controls: isotropic medoid plus same geometry cost
aggregation.oracle: min GT error over same candidates, evaluation namespace only; never used for published choice or hyperparameter selection on test

training.loss: Linear CFM: z_s=(1-s)epsilon+s*x, target=x-epsilon; mean squared velocity residual per standardized block. s~Uniform[0,1], epsilon~N(0,I). Same scalar s for all joint state blocks.
training.normalization: Each block averaged by its dimension, rotations packed columns; means/scales fitted on train only and fixed. Tangent decision scales separately documented.
training.no_default_endpoint_loss: Do not force every independent generated candidate to the one observed GT using MSE, nor train via best-of-K alone. Mesh/2D endpoint penalties are later isolated ablations.
training.partial_labels: Core full-dimensional CFM uses declared complete target samples; partial samples do not supervise fake identity hands or zero beta. If only body labels valid, train separate22-node distribution and label its narrower claim.
training.optimizer: AdamW lr3e-4 weight_decay0.01 gradient_clip1, 1000-step warmup then cosine, mixed precision only after full-precision finite smoke
training.compute_controls: Matched architecture, conditioning, data, optimizers and step budgets plus separate measured wall-time budgets; count both geometry passes, decoding and scoring
training.checkpoint_selection: Validation distribution energy score subject to validity and point-error guardrails; no test tuning
training.G1_training: Freeze G0 anchor generator; cache/recompute G0 information on train and validation using observation-only inputs. G1 trains from scratch with same recipe, consumes that information; G0 remains a declared extra model cost.
training.corruption: Real calibrated detector residuals first; synthetic stress includes whole-view dropout, structured limb occlusion, outliers, timestamp gaps and camera perturbations; randomization ranges registered from calibration before main run

data.local360: Engineering replay only; not training truth or held-out independent test
data.recommended_motion_source: Licensed AMASS matched SMPL-H subset; fitted MoSh parameters are reference labels, not independent surface truth
data.asset_gate: Verify model family, sex, beta dimension/basis, hand convention and marker-fit label validity; current male asset does not authorize unvalidated neutral/female substitution
data.no_direct_bedlam_beta_copy: BEDLAM SMPL-X beta cannot be copied into SMPL-H; any fitting conversion has its own error and evidence level
data.split: Disjoint people, motion sequences and base motions before rendering/augmentation; camera-rig holdout separate; no adjacent-frame split
data.calibration_split: Separate train, detector-calibration, validation and test people/sequences where available; scarce-data cross-fitting only inside training, never test
data.real_claim_gate: Synchronized independent 3D landmarks and shape scan or measurements with uncertainty, evaluation participants excluded from calibration and model selection. Sample size decided from participant-level pilot variance, not frame count.
data.unresolved: Licensed suitable motion dataset availability and independent real truth not established by this task; no download or collection performed

point: PVE where valid independent/reference labels exist
neutral-pose shape surface and measured dimensions
distribution: energy score on standardized joints and shape separately
90 percent interval coverage and interval width
oracle min error at fixed K
pairwise sample spread not used alone
online: mode switching with corresponding true motion
resources: model calls and evaluated candidate states
metrics.statistics: Three training seeds; participant-level paired bootstrap CI, block sequences within participant; never treat frames as independent people

acceptance.meaning: Predeclared engineering research targets, not established performance or universal significance thresholds
acceptance.generator: G1 versus compute-matched G0: >=5 percent relative energy-score reduction in preregistered ambiguity strata with paired95% CI supporting improvement; point-error deterioration <=2 percent on strong-geometry strata
acceptance.aggregation: Same cached candidates: >=5 percent selected-error reduction versus strongest deployable baseline and paired95% CI supporting improvement; retention within1 percentage point or matched risk-coverage comparison
acceptance.calibration: Target90% marginal coverage between87% and93% overall with uncertainty intervals and subgroup reporting; also report width to prevent trivial broad intervals
acceptance.validity: Invalid rate increase <=0.5 percentage point; no silent filtering, oracle inputs or causal leaks
acceptance.latency: No realtime claim until full pipeline p95<=33.3ms on declared hardware; if unmet label offline/limited-rate and report actual speed
acceptance.revision_budget: At most two justified mechanism revisions after controls are correct; if failed, retain FM research direction but withdraw this mechanism's advantage/novelty claim
